data.title: Sadbhav Infrastructure Board Backs New Auditor and Major Subsidiary Asset Divestment
data.description:
Sadbhav Infrastructure Project Ltd. ( (IN:SADBHIN) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Sadbhav Infrastructure Project Ltd. has announced that its board has recommended the appointment of M/s O R Maloo & Co as the new statutory auditor, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. This move signals a shift in the company’s audit oversight framework, which may be closely watched by investors and regulators given the importance of statutory audits for governance and compliance.

The board also approved a proposal to sell, transfer or dispose of assets exceeding 20% of the assets of its material subsidiaries, Sadbhav Maintenance Infrastructure Private Ltd. and Sadbhav Infra Solutions Private Ltd., and potentially liquidate or otherwise dispose of the company’s entire shareholding in these entities. This contemplated divestment could result in loss of control over the subsidiaries, marking a significant restructuring of the group’s asset base and potentially altering its operational footprint and risk profile for stakeholders.

data.title: JSW Steel posts 3% rise in August crude steel output, driven by strong India operations
data.description:
JSW Steel Limited ( (IN:JSWSTEEL) ) has provided an announcement.

JSW Steel Limited, India’s leading integrated steel producer and flagship company of the US$25 billion JSW Group, continues to expand its substantial capacity footprint across domestic and international operations. With 37.9 MTPA of combined crude steel capacity and a planned increase to 54.8 MTPA in four years, JSW Steel is deepening its presence in construction, infrastructure, automotive and industrial steel segments while strengthening its global sustainability and quality credentials.

The company reported consolidated crude steel production of 24.65 lakh tonnes for August 2026, marking a 3% year-on-year increase and reflecting robust operational performance. Indian operations, running at 88% capacity utilisation, grew 4% to 23.87 lakh tonnes, offsetting an 11% decline in output at JSW Steel USA – Ohio, and underscoring the continued strength of JSW Steel’s domestic franchise following the transfer of the Bhushan Power and Steel undertaking to its JSW-JFE Steel joint venture.

More about JSW Steel Limited

JSW Steel Limited is the flagship steel business of the US$25 billion diversified JSW Group, which also operates across energy, infrastructure, cement, paints, realty, e-platforms, mobility, defence, sports, and venture capital. Over three decades, JSW Steel has grown into India’s leading integrated steel producer, with a combined crude steel capacity of 37.9 MTPA, including 4.5 MTPA via the JSW JFE Steel joint venture.

Its next growth phase aims to lift combined capacity to 54.8 MTPA over the next four years, reinforcing its role in key sectors such as construction, infrastructure, automobiles, electrical applications, and appliances. The Vijayanagar plant in Karnataka, already India’s largest single-location steel facility at 19.5 MTPA, is being expanded to about 25 MTPA by FY30, positioning it to become the world’s largest steel plant.

JSW Steel maintains a strategic collaboration with Japan’s JFE Steel to access advanced technologies for high-value special steel products and has built a strong sustainability and quality reputation. It has been named WorldSteel’s Steel Sustainability Champion for eight consecutive years, holds Deming Prizes for TQM at Vijayanagar and Salem, features in major global sustainability indices, and has four operations certified under the ResponsibleSteel standard, covering more than 80% of its domestic crude steel output.
